mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the nerve routes was most worthwhile because it connected the sensors to a familiar result: keeping your eyes on a point while turning your head.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the weighted sensors was less clear: after the balance nerves were consumed, I needed a compatibility hint to see what to do next.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the weighted sensors to join the already-built turning sensor assembly rather than connect to a separate nerve item.

arbitrary.text: That assembly pairing felt a little arbitrary from the available names, although the result showed both sensors connected to incoming nerves.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: building the sensors and seeing how they help control eye movement made me curious about other body connections.
